Checkout API

Integrate collections. Server https://api.checkout.test/v3

Auth

Use an API key in the Authorization header as Bearer, or send X-API-Key.

POST /v3/payments Create a payment collection.

GET /v3/payments/{id} Fetch a payment.

GET /v3/customers List customers.

Webhook events

Events are posted to your webhook URL. Verify with HMAC using the verif-hash header.

Event Description
charge.completed Payment completed successfully
transfer.completed Payout completed 
{ "event": "charge.completed", "data": {} }

Errors

400 invalid_request The payload is malformed.

401 unauthorized Missing API key.
